correctness.rationale: Explicit commutator coordinate formula yields an exhaustive projection-rank dichotomy. Five-dimensional Heisenberg component is an affine rank-two bundle over the irreducible 3D Lagrangian Grassmannian; the second component has a rank-two affine bundle over a 3D irreducible incidence hypersurface. Degeneration families cover the full rank-zero boundary and the irreducible 4D intersection. Exact rational-point calculations use disjoint projection strata and generalize to all field extensions. The matrix cube identity in characteristic three produces three additional irreducible 4D components; p>=5 matrix powers vanish. A standalone exhaustive RREF program independently checked q=2,3,5 and p=3 elementary condition. No scheme-theoretic reducedness or certification beyond proved reduced geometry is asserted.

value.rationale: The minimal nonempty neighboring case u3 gives P1, whereas u4 has a new geometrically reducible two-plane variety of two fivefold components intersecting in a fourfold, with a full all-finite-field counting polynomial. The positive-characteristic restriction exposes a specifically modular transition: at p=3 the elementary locus has four components of unequal dimensions, compared with two at p>=5. This is a natural moduli geometry used for restricted-Lie representation support rather than an arbitrary small parameter slice. The exact count has independent future use in finite-field and support-variety questions.
